target_customer: Ecommerce and DTC brands, B2B marketers, restaurants and retailers
problem: Pop ups, forms and landing pages lose attention; PlayAbly swaps them for mini games that capture first party data.
business_model: Usage or performance based revenue share (20 to 25 percent on the cashback product per its site)

founders.name: John Cheng
founders.background_notes: Source: YC page. Gamesbeat confirms Playnomics founding and Unity acquisition.

founders.background_notes: Last name not given on the YC page or launch post.

founders.background_notes: Listed on the YC page; no bio beyond Baotris.

technical_complexity.rationale: Quiz and mini game widgets with Shopify and email integrations; moderate front end work.

defensibility.rationale: Games and quizzes are easy to copy and spin to win widgets were already common.

market_need_then: Brands wanted first party data and conversion lifts, but only company claims were found.

branding.domain_note: Uses playably.ai; the name is written both PlayAbly and Playably across sources.
branding.community_and_virality: The company runs a podcast on ecommerce gamification with dozens of episodes.

brand_strength.rationale: Name is close to generic Playable and spellings vary; podcast shows content effort but no outside brand press.

pivots.to: Gamified cashback product for Shopify brands
pivots.why: Current site shows a cashback campaign product; the earlier product is not documented

outcome_analysis: PlayAbly is listed by YC as Summer 2019 and Inactive, yet its YC page says it was founded in 2022 and its website and podcast are active with a new cashback product. No funding, exit or shutdown news was found, so the outcome and the real timeline are unclear. The cause of any failure is not public.
notes: Conflict: batch Summer 2019 versus founded 2022 on the YC page and an active site despite Inactive status. No competitor with a source dated near 2019 was found. A funding search returned only unrelated companies with similar names, so none is recorded. Founded year left null because of the conflict.
